Resolve actual work scope; it is distinct from fixed normalization owner scope.
Carrier requires one to100 entries; source states no universal cardinality or enforcement guarantee.
Nonwhitespace pressure text does not authenticate the problem or adequacy.
Carrier requires artifact_type_ref and description; source permits a deferred question and other unsettled outputs.
Nominate a route independently of authentic revision handling.
Type-level C53 meaning binding is not a per-record canonical classification map.
owner_ref and scope_ref do not directly encode scope.coordination normalization ownership.
Operational Intent/v1 type and source type.definition classification need distinct accepted maps.
No authenticated before record is stored in a revision-history entry.
No independent desired-hypothesis field is bound to a change.
Resolve after-state nomination independently of the original record and desired hypothesis.
A history rationale is not automatically bound to each changed output or nominated route.
Opaque reference lists do not create a resolved per-claim Intent link.
Resolve artifact, decision, residue or next-route target kind, scope and claimed effect independently.
